note.message: user app cannot be made on web with home /home/app: it is below /home, which everyone may write (0777 root:root), so a user other than root could put a directory or a link of their own at /home/app before useradd makes it, and useradd would take it as it is
note.hint: make /home root's and not writable by others by hand (chown root:root, chmod go-w), or declare a home below a directory only root can change

warnings.message: user app is added to group docker on web: its members control the Docker daemon, which runs containers as root with the host's files, so the user can become root there
warnings.hint: declare the group only if the user is meant to administer the node; Mamela never removes a membership, so taking it out of the declaration later does not take it away
